headline: Apple Q3 Revenue Rises 12% to Beat Estimates as China Sales Lag
summary: Apple reported a 12% increase in quarterly revenue, beating analyst estimates, while maintaining that China remains a weak spot.
why: Apple is one of the world's largest technology companies and a major component of major equity indexes. Its performance serves as a bellwether for consumer electronics demand and multinational corporate health, particularly regarding the Chinese market.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Sales beat estimates with a 12% rise in revenue.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Better-than-expected revenue figures indicate strong overall demand, driving positive market sentiment for the stock despite regional weaknesses in China.
